**Notice: Repair Café Location Change**

Beginning this Saturday, the Maplewood Repair Café will move from the library to the Community Hall on Elm Street. Volunteers should arrive at 9:30 a.m. for setup, and visitors are welcome from 10 a.m. Please bring broken household items, small appliances, or clothing needing mending. We look forward to seeing you at our new home!
task: Write a notice explaining that a fictional neighborhood repair cafe will move its Saturday session from the library to the community hall. Volunteers should arrive at 9:30 and visitors at 10.
